title: Chapter 1347 - 24: Uprising

Chapter 1347 - 24: Uprising

Chapter 1347: Chapter 24: Uprising

"Finally..."

The lines of illusory text in his vision gradually dissipated as Lin Yuan gently closed his eyes.

For the past fifty years, Lin Yuan had tried various methods to kill the Emperor of Da Feng.

Assassination.

Poisoning.

Seduction.

And so on and so forth.

But the success rate was not very high.

Among ten future timelines, only about three or four ended with the successful assassination of the Da Feng Emperor.

Once the first attempt failed, the success rate of trying to assassinate the Da Feng Emperor again by the same means plummeted.

Only this time, Lin Yuan used the momentum he had accumulated over seventy years to hold back almost all the forces of the Da Feng Dynasty.

He then ventured alone into the imperial palace and successfully killed the Da Feng Emperor.

From beginning to end.

It was almost seamless.

No variables arose in the process.

"Watch a little longer."

Lin Yuan collected his thoughts.

Attempting once again to observe the future timelines.

[You killed the Da Feng Emperor...]

...

[You killed the Da Feng Emperor...]

...

[You killed the Da Feng Emperor...]

...

He continuously observed several dozen future timelines.

Through this method, the probability of breaking into the capital’s imperial palace and assassinating the Da Feng Emperor was nearly one hundred percent.

This is the advantage of absolute power.

If Lin Yuan were alone, without relying on any external aid,

not to say that it would be impossible to kill the Da Feng Emperor, but there would definitely be numerous variables.

No matter how much one strategizes and calculates, it would be futile.

Variables will always exist.

"However..."

Lin Yuan furrowed his brows slightly.

In the dozens of future timelines he just observed.

After he killed the Da Feng Emperor, the cyclical time did not end.

He still waited for the limitation of his lifespan.

"Is it the future glimpsed through the Rune Dao that cannot truly break through this cyclical time world, or is it something else?"

Lin Yuan fell into brief contemplation.

But very soon.

His gaze turned to the outside world.

At this moment, within Black Wind Village, waves of spiritual power fluctuations could be felt.

Since Black Wind Village was Lin Yuan’s base of operations, he had naturally set up many contingencies.

However, to lure the Tao Suppression Department Chief, Lin Yuan had long since withdrawn most of the Entering Dao Masters from Black Wind Village.

Now, the number of Entering Dao Masters within Black Wind Village was just seven or eight, aptly within the manageable range for the Tao Suppression Department Chief.

If there were too many Entering Dao Masters, exceeding the maximum that the Tao Suppression Department Chief could handle, the opponent would notice and undoubtedly turn and leave without hesitation.

As for having the numerous Entering Dao Masters hide?

The other Entering Dao Masters lacked Lin Yuan’s ability to perfectly conceal their own auras.

This isn’t a matter of secret techniques but of complete control over oneself.

And dealing with twenty or thirty Entering Dao Masters, Lin Yuan could handle it on his own.

He didn’t need others to share the burden.

Black Wind Village is unlike the imperial palace.

It has no territorial advantage.

With the strength Lin Yuan accumulated over seventy years of arduous cultivation, he could completely sweep away all Entering Dao Masters.

In all the previous observations of future timelines, Lin Yuan perished in the capital and the imperial palace, not because he was overpowered and killed.

But because he was worn down after exhausting his physical, mental, and spiritual energy.

This cyclical world is made of mortal flesh, and even slightly transcendent spiritual power is rooted in the physical body.

A weak body cannot nurture an endless stream of spiritual power.

Even someone as strong as Lin Yuan would eventually die from depletion.

This is why, over the decades, Lin Yuan devoted a large portion of his energy to building his subordinate forces.

Lin Yuan speculated that this might be the time loop’s test for him?

In the past, Lin Yuan always pushed through everything, even when leveraging his forces, it was merely temporary, and he ultimately relied on his absolute power to suppress all enemies.

However, in this cyclical time world, without cultivating a sufficiently powerful force, it would be impossible to even confront the Da Feng Emperor, let alone assassinate him.

"Since the fish took the bait, it’s time to reel it in."

Lin Yuan stood up, and at this moment, within his perception, more than twenty Entering Dao Masters from the Tao Suppression Department were locked in combat with the seven or eight Entering Dao Masters left to guard Black Wind Village.

...

Within Black Wind Village, the aura of the masters continually collided.

"Good, good, traitors and rebels, merely Black Wind Village, and yet it harbors eight Masters?"

The Tao Suppression Department Chief was both shocked and furious. Even though he had already known that Black Wind Village was unfathomable and that the Black Wind Village Chief must possess Master-level strength.

But eight Entering Dao Masters?

And they were Masters he had never seen before?

The Tao Suppression Department of Da Feng, which monitors the entire realm, had allowed eight Masters to emerge unnoticed right under his nose?

It’s important to know that Master-level combat strength is extremely rare. In Da Feng, apart from the official Masters, there are only about forty or fifty Masters.

These forty or fifty Masters are scattered across ninety-eight provinces.

As a result, in such a small place as Black Mountain, in such a small Black Wind Village, eight Masters were hidden?

"Form the formation immediately."

The Tao Suppression Department Chief glanced at the other twenty-two Entering Dao Masters.

The sudden appearance of eight Entering Dao Masters had shattered the limit for the Tao Suppression Department Chief.

Even though the base of a faction is the most important place and usually concentrates the most strong ones,

it is definitely not where all its strong members are located; just the base alone having eight Entering Dao Masters means that other provinces have sent equivalent experts to oversee them.

The Entering Dao Masters under the Black Wind Village Chief’s command numbered at least over ten, perhaps even approaching twenty.

A mere faction, yet it controls nearly half of the Masters outside of the official ones in the realm, with resources and influence.

This outcome caused a chill to creep into the Tao Suppression Department Chief’s heart.

"Yes."

The twenty-two Entering Dao Masters exchanged glances.

Their spiritual powers began to merge.

The so-called formation is an extremely powerful Entering Dao secret technique mastered by Da Feng.

It allows spiritual power at the Master level to merge together.

Thereby unleashing terrifying power beyond that of an ordinary Entering Dao Master.

This Secret Technique of Entering Dao, although terrifying, has very high requirements for Heavenly Masters.

It requires extreme harmony and cooperation.

Only the Entering Dao Masters trained by the Da Feng Dynasty can perform such a Secret Technique.

The current situation makes the Tao Suppression Department Chief feel apprehensive, already deciding on a swift victory, directly suppressing the eight Heavenly Masters within Black Wind Village.

Rustle, rustle.

The ample Spiritual Power swept down, covering the entire Black Wind Village.

The eight Entering Dao Masters, who were struggling to resist, changed their expressions dramatically and began to retreat without hesitation.

"Too late."

The Tao Suppression Department Chief’s expression was cold, as soon as the twenty-three Entering Dao Masters formed their array, the spiritual cage created would immediately take shape.

It essentially declared the fate of the eight Entering Dao Masters of Black Wind Village.

Just as the Tao Suppression Department Chief was thinking about how, after suppressing these eight Entering Dao Masters, to extract more information from them.

"Boom—"

A sound of a footstep resounded, though barely noticeable, it stirred ripples on the spiritual level.

"Boom, boom, boom—"

The footsteps came closer, each step pressing on the minds of the twenty-three Entering Dao Masters.

"Boom—"

The final footstep sounded.

The Tao Suppression Department Chief and the twenty-three Entering Dao Masters turned pale, retreating several steps as the spiritual cage they had formed collapsed directly.

"This..."

The Tao Suppression Department Chief stared intently into the depths of Black Wind Village.

Just a slender figure slowly emerged.

This slender figure was a young man, imposing and charismatic, with an aura deep and distant.

"Master."

The eight Entering Dao Masters who narrowly escaped disaster saw Lin Yuan, their expressions ecstatic, and immediately bowed and shouted.

"Master? Are you the Black Wind Village Chief?"

The Tao Suppression Department Chief’s face turned solemn.

Although there had been no direct confrontation, the fact that the opponent, merely through footsteps, broke their array of twenty-three Entering Dao Masters’ Secret Technique left the Tao Suppression Department Chief’s heart trembling.

At the same time, a thought suddenly flashed through his mind.

How could such a powerful Entering Dao Master possibly leave such a telltale sign of vulnerability?

"Go!"

The Tao Suppression Department Chief suddenly retreated explosively.

The other twenty-two Entering Dao Masters, as if with mutual understanding, likewise retreated explosively in different directions.

The means Lin Yuan just demonstrated made the Tao Suppression Department Chief perceive immense danger, and he further associated his ability to locate here might have been deliberately orchestrated by the opponent.

In this situation, it was like falling into a trap, and he certainly couldn’t stay long.

"You’re too late as well."

Lin Yuan smiled slightly.

The surging ocean-like Spiritual Power poured out, in an instant, everywhere around, filling with tangible Spiritual Power.

Including the Tao Suppression Department Chief, all twenty-three Entering Dao Masters were grabbed back like chickens, falling before Lin Yuan.

"Spiritual manifestation? Such a vast range of spiritual manifestation? Monster, you are a monster!"

The Tao Suppression Department Chief felt despaired, the more he understood the level of the Heavenly Masters, the more he realized the unimaginable nature of the Spiritual Power Lin Yuan had just demonstrated.

The Tao Suppression Department Chief was in charge of all the intelligence of Da Feng, this era’s intelligence, the previous era’s intelligence, the era before that...

He understood the ultimate pursuit of Entering Dao Masters was spiritual manifestation.

However, most Entering Dao Masters never reached this step in their lifetime.

A few peak Entering Dao Masters started spiritual manifestation by luck, but even using all their Spiritual Power, they could only manifest a range of several meters.

But just now, Lin Yuan?

If not experienced firsthand, the Tao Suppression Department Chief would never believe that any Heavenly Master could achieve that level of spiritual manifestation.

...

Having resolved the twenty-three Heavenly Masters from the Da Feng Dynasty, including the high-ranking Tao Suppression Department Chief.

Lin Yuan instructed the eight Heavenly Masters under his command, then returned once more to the depths of Black Wind Village.

However, this time Lin Yuan went not to the quiet room for retreat.

But to another room.

An elderly man with white hair sat inside.

His expression was slightly uneasy.

He was precisely Elder Uncle.

Eighty years had passed.

This elder who once desperately protected Lin Yuan and fled the court’s eradication was now nearing one hundred and thirty years old.

If it weren’t for Lin Yuan channeling his Spiritual Power to clear his blood and energy periodically.

Elder Uncle would have died of old age long ago.

One hundred and thirty years? Even as an Entering Dao Master? Most wouldn’t live this long.

Lin Yuan still retains his youth because of his perfect control over his blood and energy.

Even so, Lin Yuan estimates his ultimate lifespan would only be one hundred seventy-seven to one hundred seventy-eight years.

Not counting the eighteen years passing during the crossing.

In this cyclical world, Lin Yuan can live at most one hundred fifty years.

That means his ultimate lifespan approaches one hundred seventy-eight years.

"Young Master."

Elder Uncle saw Lin Yuan entering, immediately stood, and with a worried expression asked, "Just now, outside..."

"It’s a minor issue, all resolved now."

Lin Yuan smiled as he spoke.

"That’s good."

Elder Uncle breathed a sigh of relief.

Having lived to the present, Elder Uncle had seen through everything.

Now his only hope is to see Lin Yuan continue onward.

"Elder Uncle."

Lin Yuan sat beside him, slowly speaking, "What did the Red Lotus Sect want to do back then?"

"The Red Lotus Sect?"

Elder Uncle hesitated slightly.

At this moment, the Red Lotus Sect for him was an exceedingly distant memory.

"The Red Lotus Sect was the heart and soul of the sect leader, his life’s pursuit was nothing other than overthrowing Da Feng, but..."

Elder Uncle shook his head slightly, over the years he had also become aware of many hidden secrets of the Da Feng Dynasty, realizing how laughable the idea the Red Lotus Sect had back then.

"Hmm."

Lin Yuan nodded.

He clapped his hands.

A figure hidden in the shadows emerged, bowing toward Lin Yuan, "Master."

Lin Yuan looked at Elder Uncle, "Then according to Elder Uncle’s intentions..."

Then glanced at the figure emerging from the shadows:

"Start the uprising."
